prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a refined replacement logo presentation for the brand MIRON from these two supplied brandboard references. This is a faithful refinement, not a new visual direction.
REFERENCE 1: use ONLY the large ribbon M in the upper-left corner of image 1. This exact soft ribbon construction is the primary reference.
REFERENCE 2: use ONLY the uppercase MIRON lettering in the upper-left corner of image 2. Match its restrained weight and letter proportions.
Canvas: clean uniform near-black charcoal #141416, landscape 3:2. Two isolated elements centered on the same vertical axis: ribbon M above, wordmark MIRON below. No border, no panels, no other objects, labels, slogans, captions or mockups. Generous whitespace. M width about 36% canvas; wordmark width about 66% canvas, wordmark cap height about 9% canvas. The symbol should be clearly more prominent vertically than the lettering.
RIBBON M: reproduce the elegant silhouette of reference 1 precisely: broad white left upright, rounded upper-left shoulder turning smoothly into a diagonal descending toward the center; the ribbon gently bends and twists in the low middle valley, then sweeps diagonally upward to the right in pink. Right upright pink; clean diagonal negative-space separation near the top-right. Stable upright silhouette, not a knot or an infinity loop. The center bend must be soft and continuous with natural curvature and subtle overlapping planes. Color travels softly from pearly white through pale blush into warm saturated pink around the twist. Gentle satin shading and subtle self-shadow explain the fold. No hard colored polygon on top, no sharp patch at the crossing, no abrupt color seam. Smooth, refined, nearly flat satin ribbon, like the top-left original, not a thick extruded metallic object.
WORDMARK text verbatim: "MIRON" (M I R O N), uppercase white. Closely follow the second reference: airy tracking, geometric custom letterforms, thin-to-medium uniform stroke, polished and optically balanced. The M in the wordmark is a straight angular letter, distinct from the ribbon symbol. I is a plain vertical stroke. R has no left vertical stem: a short horizontal top bar entering a rounded right bowl and a concise diagonal leg, exactly the compact open R of reference 2. O is a clean circular ring with two small, precise diagonal cuts at northeast and southwest; same visual weight as the letters. N conventional angular geometry. All five letters share a consistent cap height and baseline, no oversized R or O, clean optical spacing.
Finish: premium brand master artwork, sharp clean outlines and carefully controlled soft shading only inside ribbon. Avoid the previous flat amateur SVG appearance, angular center bend, disconnected central patch, bulky lettering, chrome, neon glow, plastic bevels, heavy reflections, drop shadows onto background, perspective, humans, app icons, fitness props, watermarks.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean standalone brand symbol image from the supplied artwork. Keep only the large white/pink ribbon M, remove the MIRON lettering beneath. Preserve the M geometry, exact colors and satin fold shading, including rounded upper-left shoulder, pale blush central twist, pink rising diagonal and right upright. Uniform solid near-black charcoal background #141416, all negative spaces the exact same background. No transparency. Zero glow, zero shadow outside the logo, no added lighting, no mist, no noise or particles. Preserve the clean original artwork look. Center the symbol fully visible, large, on a landscape canvas around 3:2 with comfortable margins. Crisp, polished and smooth, with no text or other elements.

Use case: logo-brand. Create the standalone MIRON wordmark on an absolutely plain white background. Reproduce the attached MIRON custom wordmark faithfully with solid dark graphite letter fill, no ribbon symbol. Text exactly uppercase "MIRON", M I R O N. Restrained thin-medium uniform strokes, angular M and N, vertical I, open R with no left vertical stem, slanted start of top bar, rounded right bowl, short middle bar and diagonal leg. O circular with two small opposite diagonal gaps at northeast and southwest. Airy but optically balanced tracking, all letters on one baseline with equal cap heights. The MIRON lettering in the upper left of the second supplied brandboard is the definitive reference for letter shapes and weight. Crisp smooth letter contours, pure flat fill, pure solid white background, no gradient or shadow or grain. Wide landscape image around 3:1, with even comfortable margins. No other elements, no captions, no watermark.
